  • Top notes: Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Pineapple
  • Heart notes: Pink Pepper, Patchouli, Vetiver
  • Base notes: Ambroxan, Musk

How it wears

Juicy fruit at the start, then a drier, peppery wood as the vetiver and patchouli appear. That balance of fresh and earthy makes it easy to wear across seasons, from daytime in spring to nights out in autumn. In parfum strength the fruit and woods come across with plenty of body.

  • Parfum
  • Unisex: for men and women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
